Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sector

Class SectorManager

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.sector.SectorManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SectorManager extends Object implements Serializable
Creates and owns the sectors of a venue.

It groups every ROWS_PER_SECTOR consecutive rows (taken from the SensorNetwork) into one Sector, each with its own DisplayPanel. Each panel is anchored on the centre-corridor node of the sector's middle row, so it sits in the central aisle just like a real suspended sign. This is the entry point the dashboard and controllers use to read or drive every panel at once.

Version:
1.0
Author:
GROUPE E
